'''Bataui Zeel''' was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served in the [[Jedi Covenant]] as a [[Covenant Shadow]], an agent whose records of existence had been erased and who was known only to a few of the Covenant's members. Zeel was notably familiar with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].
